title: You can be close to Jesus and still miss Him—like Judas (John 13:27)
paragraphs: You can be close to Jesus and still miss Him—like Judas (John 13:27)
That line cuts deep. Here’s a sharpened version in the Gospel Warrior tone:

You can sit at Jesus’ table and still betray His heart—just ask Judas.
He walked with Christ. Heard the sermons. Saw the miracles. Held the money bag.
Close enough to kiss the Savior.
Still far enough to sell Him.
“And after the morsel, Satan entered into him...” (John 13:27)

Because proximity is not surrender.
Ministry is not intimacy.
A public seat near Jesus does not guarantee a private heart for Jesus.

But here’s what we miss: Judas did not fall in one night.
He was near the Light while feeding the dark.
He stayed around holiness without letting holiness break him.
And that is how a man can be beside Jesus—yet miss Him completely.

Beloved, church attendance cannot save you.
Bible knowledge cannot save you.
Even serving in ministry cannot save you.
Only repentance and faith in Jesus Christ can.

The warning is sharp.
But the grace is still stronger.

You do not have to end like Judas.
Peter also failed—but he turned back.
Judas hid in despair. Peter ran into mercy.
That is the difference grace makes.

So ask yourself honestly:
Am I just around Jesus… or have I truly surrendered to Him?

Come close.
Not just with your body.
With your heart.
